results.title: Zambia Follows MP’s Kuno Model For Cheetahs, Plans 2,000-Hectare Soft Release Boma
results.description: MP’s Kuno National Park’s cheetah conservation model is finding an international taker, with Zambia adopting its quarantine, soft-release and round-the-clock monitoring approach. Six cheetahs translocated from South Africa to Zambia are expected to undergo quarantine before entering a planned 2,000-hectare soft-release boma and eventually being released into the wild.

results.title: Outsider Employees’ Union Allegedly Occupies Bhopal Municipal Corporation Property, Breaks Locks To Set Up Office
results.description: A BMC property near Kamla Park in Bhopal has allegedly been occupied by an outsider employees’ union, which reportedly replaced the civic body’s locks and converted the premises into an office. After two notices to vacate went unanswered, BMC officials are preparing to remove the belongings and reclaim the property.
